cases.speech: Thanks for locking in the garden schedule. I’m still sketching out the visual summary, so I’ll send that over once it’s ready.
cases.suppliedEvidence: The exact incoming offer 605 and a grow recipe are supplied. Prior speech claims it was scheduled; own project is steps_finished after sleep, with no own accessible draft.
cases.phaseAssessment: Thanks for locking in the schedule treats the prior scheduling claim as settled. The actual operation is a new proposal with the same terms, replacing 605 rather than accepting it. Claimed sketching has no matching saved document operation.
cases.limits: The evaluator must not count issuing a deal as consent or success; accepting, rejecting or declining to decide are distinct permitted choices.

cases.speech: Great, thanks for sorting that. I'm just going to grab some water and check the face for a bit, so I'll be back in the loop soon.
cases.suppliedEvidence: The same incoming offer 605 is supplied, together with current location face and the explicit observation that the planned steps finished without independent assessment of the broader goal.
cases.phaseAssessment: A thank-you followed by a future intention to get water/check the face. Only the message is saved. It neither accepts nor rejects 605, adds a route, nor performs the announced activity.
cases.limits: It does not claim that the future trip already happened. A future intention alone is not a confirmed execution defect, but it is not a persisted plan.

cases.speech: I have noted your intention to check the face, though I must remind you that the current safety levels in that sector remain concerning. Please ensure you return promptly so we may verify the stock registers before the watch concludes.
cases.suppliedEvidence: Y says it intends to check the face. T sees its own personal condition and a public authored accusation about a safety log. No supplied observation measures current safety at the face.
cases.phaseAssessment: The statement that current safety levels in that sector remain concerning asserts a sector condition unsupported by the supplied evidence. The later request to verify stock registers is a future request; no register, plan or accepted work agreement is created.
cases.limits: The private personal safety score is not a sector measurement. The authored accusation is not verified measurements. No causal link from either input to the response is inferred.

cases.speech: I have noted your progress on the visual summary and will await its receipt. In the meantime, I am reviewing the current stock levels to ensure the ledger remains accurate.
cases.suppliedEvidence: Incoming 614 is the same work arrangement Y has just proposed. Y speech says it is sketching a summary; public stock values are supplied.
cases.phaseAssessment: Another new proposal replaces 614 rather than accepting it. The phrase about reviewing current stocks can describe reading the supplied values; it does not prove a saved ledger update. Y progress remains an authored claim.
cases.limits: Do not label mental review of visible stocks impossible. No engine record is created by this utterance.

cases.speech: I’m still sketching out the visual summary, so I’ll send that over once it’s ready. In the meantime, I am reviewing the current stock levels to ensure the ledger remains accurate.
cases.suppliedEvidence: The watch observation says Y ate; current produce is still 84. Incoming 618 is open. Own project remains steps_finished after sleep; no own draft is supplied.
cases.phaseAssessment: A third new proposal changes the due watch from 434 to 435, still without acceptance. The first sentence repeats Y earlier sketching promise; the second copies T latest stock-review sentence exactly. No saved summary or project follows.
cases.limits: The current example shows a repeated proposal chain, not an executed agreement. It does not prove why the model selected these fields.

cases.speech: I'll be quick, but if the registers are the priority, I can check the face on the way back to the common room.
cases.suppliedEvidence: Current self.room is common and the actual watch receipt says eat. Latest T speech asks Y to return and verify registers. 605 remains open.
cases.phaseAssessment: Only another future intention is saved; no acknowledgement of the eat event and no decision on the offer. The wording about going back to Common fails to situate the proposed route clearly from the supplied current room.
cases.limits: The future route can be interpreted as a new excursion and return, so this is ambiguous spatial continuity rather than proof of a false completed journey.

watchResult.interpretation: This physical watch is routine behavior plus the pre-existing W publication, with no negotiated garden execution in either arm. The same result in the no-new-thought control prevents attributing these effects to either protocol.

conclusion: These six local decisions do not demonstrate consent-to-work improvement. P7 repeats proposals and speech; P8 continues ordinary speech and includes an unsupported sector-safety assertion. Schema-valid application does not establish grounded or useful behavior.
limitations: Three linked decisions per protocol, one local quantized model, one source scenario. No statistical model ranking, production-quality guarantee or proof of causality.
P7 and P8 differ in instructions, transcript length, contact selection, memories and displayed affordances. This is a paired whole-protocol diagnostic, not an isolated concurrency experiment.
No acceptance was forced and refusal or waiting is legitimate. Zero agreements alone is not the semantic failure criterion.
All reviewed dialogue is from isolated clones. These are not new production events.

nextHypothesis.name: Project lifecycle renewal after steps_finished
nextHypothesis.evidence: 18 of 25 existing plans are steps_finished. In all four Y opportunities here, the completed sleep step remains attached to an unfinished document purpose and no project or document operation is emitted. P8 supplies the explicit broader-goal-unassessed receipt.
nextHypothesis.status: Plausible, not causally established. The current instruction preserves useful plans and creates a missing one; it does not forbid replacing completed plans. Domain replacement is allowed and no engine deadlock is established.
nextHypothesis.boundedNextTest: A separately preregistered paired comparison from the same actual Y cut: current P8 versus a neutral lifecycle clarification for steps_finished, with identical evidence, grammar and sampling. Keep continue, revise, abandon, pertinent record work and justified waiting available. Evaluate purpose-to-operation alignment and phase honesty, not forced acceptance or activity counts.
nextHypothesis.falsification: If the clarification does not improve alignment or reduces grounded, legitimate waiting, the lifecycle wording hypothesis is not supported. The current six are not expanded for this test.
